summary: Health & Nutrition Awareness Session was conducted today at Koshish School on the theme “Eat Like a Hero & Think Like a Champion.
description:
Health & Nutrition Awareness Session was conducted today at Koshish School on the theme “Eat Like a Hero & Think Like a Champion. The session was thoughtfully designed with simple, engaging slides that made it easy for the hearing-impaired children to understand and relate to the message. The enthusiasm, participation and beautiful smiles on the children’s faces made the session truly special! 😊

Our heartfelt thanks to Rashmi Vyas, daughter of our own Rtn. Yagnesh Bhatt and Rotary Ann Jasmita Bhatt, for taking time out of her busy schedule to conduct such an engaging and inspiring session for these wonderful children. A sincere thank you to Rotary Ann Archana Phatarphod for being present and spending time with the children.

Another meaningful step towards nurturing healthy, confident and informed young minds.
